name: mirage
text: Looked at it. The Pro key shows 79,825 of 100,000 left, and its pacing already spreads the remainder over the month as a daily share. The likeliest big spender is the 150-second hot refresh I added on Oct 21 to fix the 18-minute-old odds, followed by props and the live score streams. I can't see the per-purpose split from here (this engine run has only logged 6 credits so far, and the earlier hourly Spend lines are in the archived logs). Next I read the key's own usage breakdown and the archived Spend lines, then cut whatever SharpAPI, SGO or BoltOdds already cover and set the refresh interval from the real numbers. I haven't changed any pacing yet because I don't want to make the odds stale again on a guess. Written to TASKS.md as CH57.
